signal: Tessell raised a $60M Series B led by WestBridge (with Lightspeed) to expand its AI-native multi-cloud DBaaS platform and go-to-market.

email.body1:
Varsha, saw Tessell raised a $60M Series B led by WestBridge with Lightspeed to expand its multi-cloud DBaaS platform.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps spend time in meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Varsha, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise, the GTM expansion usually surfaces more accounts than a BDR team can work. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Tessell needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Varsha, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph, also in data infrastructure, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Varsha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
